conditions.displayName: At least five HTTP 5xx responses in a minute

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "atmem-chatgpt" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Inspect the AtMem Cloud service's aggregate errors without copying memory contents or credentials. Check /health and recent deployment state. Never roll back to pre-account-fence code. No notification channel is configured by this policy; an operator must select a verified destination. This is not a spending cap.
